args: Authorize ONLY high_alignment. Assess the actual open hand swept path to this pad-center target and orientation, including fingers and nearby bowl, bottle, stove and cabinet. The high alignment stays at current altitude; vertical_pregrasp stops 65 mm above the package top. Do not require retention or later bowl fit. Confirm the measured package has not moved. Unknown is not clear.

geometry.aperture_assumption: Symmetric prismatic joint separation less one transverse pad-size allowance is a conservative screening model, not measured inner-face clearance; fresh visible straddling is also required.
geometry.p0_identity: White curled capital C beginning Cream near the upper end of the printed blue logo.
geometry.geometry_scope: Original same-frame upper boundary and planes, independently checked local top/support samples, and a new lower grasp target; actual pose margins must pass before closure.

result.explanation: Clear for high_alignment only. Including the open fingers and the small orientation change, the supplied geometry puts the lowest swept finger surface at approximately 1.173 m. The visible bowl, bottle and stove are below this high sweep; the cabinet is laterally outside it. No external obstruction is visible in this local swept path. The package matches the recorded frame-0 location and orientation, and no native steps have occurred.

parameters.notes: Authorization applies only to the stated constant-altitude high_alignment target and orientation. It does not authorize vertical_pregrasp, lower descent, closure or transfer. Package agreement is same-frame evidence, not an independent later observation. Returned regions provide visible obstacle geometry, not hidden surfaces or a full-scene clearance certificate.
